programme.desc: Granny Zanny / Croc Gets a Job. Crocodile tries to impress Daisy's grandmother when she comes to visit. Mr. Crocodile realizes he doesn't have an official "job" and goes in search of the perfect one.

programme.title: The Creature Cases
programme.desc: The Puzzle of the Poisonous Leaves / The Mystery of the Missing Hare. Something's funky in the food at a jungle resort in 'The Puzzle of the Poisonous Leaves', and in 'The Mystery of the Missing Hare', Snowshoe hares need to find a missing camper.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Super Mega Movie Screen / The Crew Builds An Auntie Day Present. Speed Meister ruins the Drive-In movie in 'The Crew Builds a Super Mega Movie Screen', then in 'The Crew Builds an Auntie Day Present', the pups make a gift for Auntie Crane.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Giant Skate Track / The Crew Builds A Giant Ice Cream Maker. The pups help River take photos in a flash in 'The Crew Builds a Giant Skate Track', then in 'The Crew Bulids a Giant Ice Cream Maker', Speed Meister ruins ice cream day.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide. Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide: The Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum. (S14, ep 3b).

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups redden Spettergat. A team of pups led by the energetic Ryder are always at the ready when it comes to helping out around the bustling town of Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Pizza / Pups Save Skye. Pups Save a Pizza: Alex and Mr Porter are delivering pizza for a big party when the van spins out of control. Pups to the rescue!

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Puppet / Gloop Gloop Ah-Ah. The Barbababies decide to create a show and go all out in 'The Puppet', then in 'Gloop Gloop Ah-Ah', Barbotine wants to create the best lemonade.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Living Together / Holey the Snowman. The Barbababies take the train and sleep in a hotel in 'Living Together', then in 'Holey The Snowman', Barbouille crafted a magnificent snowman that the children named Bobo.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Mountain Eater / The First Day Of School. Barbapapa tells the Barbababies about his extraordinary encounter with a wolf in 'The Mountain Eater', then in 'The First Day Of School', tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school.

programme.title: Santiago Of The Seas
programme.desc: Lorelai's Bracelet / Cecelia and the Ghost Ship. Bonnie steals Lorelai's bracelet, turning herself into a mermaid and while trapping Lorelai in human form! Santi and crew must overcome ghostly shenanigans to save Cecilia from the dreaded Ghost Ship.

programme.title: Santiago Of The Seas
programme.desc: To the Lighthouse / The Golden Giant. When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You
programme.desc: The Smelly Smell. The Smelly Smell: Yikes, there's a smelly smell in the house, and nobody nose where it's coming from! We need the Smell-busters to figure it out as we learn more about the five senses! (S4, ep 18).

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Marble Run. Peppa, George, Rebecca and Richard Rabbit have so much fun playing with their marble run. When Daddy Pig joins in, the marble run gets much bigger!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Recycling. There is nothing more fun than sailing a boat .. isn't it? Peppa is a little dissatisfied with her boat at first, but then she discovers that sailing with paper boats is the most fun!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Daddy Pig's Office. It is Sports Day at Peppa's playgroup. There are lots of exciting events, including running, jumping and the "tug of war". Daddy Pig tells Peppa that it's not the winning that matters.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Pirate Island. Grandpa and Granny Pig are taking Peppa, George and their friends to Pirate Island. Grandpa shows how to use his metal detector to find treasures and they all build a big sandcastle.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Jumble Sale. Peppa and George want to go to the playground with Papa and Mama Pig. But a fog sets in and they get lost. When Papa Pig thinks they are back home, the fog clears and they are… in the playground!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Swimming. Today is George's birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Foggy Day. Mummy and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can't see. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: George's Birthday. Today is George's birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Tiny Creatures. Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail. Then Grandpa also shows them his beehive.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Sports Day. It is Sports Day at Peppa's playgroup. There are lots of exciting events, including running, jumping and the "tug of war". Daddy Pig tells Peppa that it's not the winning that matters.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grandad Dog's Garage. Peppa's car runs out of petrol but thankfully Granddad Dog's garage isn't far away. With one phone call, Granddad Dog is on his way. He tows Peppa's car back to his garage.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Balloon Ride. The Balloon Ride: Peppa and her family win a trip on Miss Rabbit's hot air balloon, but get stuck in a tree in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Adventures In Plantsitting/ Andrea the Alebrije. Dora babysits Baby Flowers to help Isa in 'Adventures In Plantsitting', then in 'Andrea the Alebrije', Dora helps Andrea the Alebrije find her magical leaf. (S2, ep 8).

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Run Cynthia Run. Dora and Boots get help from Carmelo the Condor to fix their friend's running shoes in time for the rainforest race!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile
programme.desc: Buzzy Croc / Dream House. Mr. Crocodile worries about his old and new best friends in 'Buzzy Croc', then in 'Dream House', Daisy and Mr. Crocodile's treehouse gets busy when they add space for all their friends.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Barbapapa Family / The House of Barbapapa. Barbapapa finds refuge in the house that Francois' parents built in 'The Barbapapa Family', but in 'Barbapapa's Home', the house is too small now Barbamama and the Barbabebe have arrived.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Going With the Flow. Going With The Flow: The Barbababies are bored, as the rain is preventing them from playing outside. Fortunately, with a little imagination, you can do lots of things when it's raining. (S2, ep 16a).

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Hotel Elevator / The Crew Builds A Popcorn-Cat Café. Rubble & Crew help Hadley's hotel guests in 'The Crew Builds a Hotel Elevator', then in 'The Crew Builds a Popcorn-Cat Cafe', Cafe Carl has a case of kitten chaos!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer. Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide. Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide: The Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum. (S14, ep 3b).

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups redden Spettergat. A team of pups led by the energetic Ryder are always at the ready when it comes to helping out around the bustling town of Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Babysitter. Pups Save the Babysitter: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the Paw Patrol when animal hijinks occur at the farm. (S14, ep 2b).

programme.title: Santiago Of The Seas
programme.desc: The Silver Lasso / The Sea Dragon's Treasure. Santiago and Mami team up to take down an old foe in 'The Silver Lasso', and in 'The Sea Dragon's Treasure', Enrique nabs a golden egg, so it's up to the good pirates to nab it back. (S1, ep 13).

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Petting Farm. Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm where they meet lots of little animals and learn it's important to wash your hands.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Pizza! Pizza!. Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: TV Land. Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Roman Day. Granny Pig, Peppa and George have fun dressing up as Romans, making a pebble mosaic and learning a little Latin!

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Treasure Hunt / Going into the Wild. The barbababies enjoy the great outdoors in 'The Treasure Hunt', and in 'Going into the Wild', The Barbapapas are off to a new adventure... in the garden. Living in nature is complicated!

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Clock and Dance. The dazzling return to the world's screens of the most pop family of them all! BARBAPAPA – One big happy family!

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups en de held van de lucht // Pups redden de oppas. Follow our pawsome pack of pups as they take on more exciting new missions! Whether it's exciting rescues in new locations around Adventure Bay, new pup pals and action-packed rescues are on the way!

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away from Home. Mayor Humdinger takes his trailer and his kitties out for a sunny, desert vacation. But when his irresponsible driving lands them at the tippy top of a tall spire.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds Library Treasure Tunnels / The Crew Builds A Super Snack Dispenser. The pups dig tunnels for new books in 'The Crew Builds Library Treasure Tunnels', then in 'The Crew Builds a Super Snack Dispenser', Mix, Charger, and Wheeler surprise Rubble. (S2, ep 4).

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Hair Salon / The Crew Builds A Colorful Crystal Show. Grandpa has a pink problem at the hair salon in 'The Crew Builds a Hair Salon', then in 'The Crew Builds a Colourful Crystal Show', Lily makes a shiny discovery. (S2, ep 5).

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: The Little Axolotl / Bubble Trouble. Dora and Boots get a baby back to its mama in 'The Little Axolotl', and in 'Bubble Trouble', Dora must save the Big Red Chicken who floats away in a bubble right before the big talent show. (S1, ep 6).

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: The Rainforest Ritmo / The Magic Nut. Isa's throwing a party where everyone will be dancing in 'The Rainforest Ritmo', then in 'The Magic Nut', Dora leads everyone into the Tricky Trappy Forest to recover Tico's magic nut. (S1, ep 7).

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Rebels / Barbascience. Barbidur and Barbalala become little rebels in 'Rebels', but then in 'Barbascience', we ask who are the Barbapapa? (S2, ep 19).

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Barbababies Have Got Talent / Triple Switcheroo. Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage. Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather!

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Vandal! / Tumbles, Where Did You Go?. Barbidur catches a mysterious masked vandal in 'Vandal!', then in 'Tumbles, Where Did You Go?', Tototutu, Barbidur's favourite little car, has mysteriously disappeared. (S2, ep 21).

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: I'm Not a Barbababy Anymore / Roboxman. No! It's over! Barbidur is no longer a baby, he's a big boy now! The barbababies are going to the hypermarket for the first time.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Buttercup / We Need To Save the Corals. Barbidou's beautiful roses mysteriously disappear in 'Buttercup', then in 'We Need To Save The Corals', Barbapapa tells us about the time he went to explore the Arctic and the seabed. (S2, ep 23).

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Winter Wonderland / The Crew Builds A Giant Snow Squirrely Whirly. Winter becomes wonderful with Rubble & Crew in 'The Crew Builds A Winter Wonderland', then in 'The Crew Builds A Giant Snow Squirrely Whirly', the pups learn to build with snow! (S2, ep 21).

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Hotel / The Crew Builds A Hiking Trail. The pups build the first hotel in town in 'The Crew Builds A Hotel', and then in 'The Crew Builds A Hiking Trail', the crew saves a duck birthday party. (S2, ep 22).

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide. Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide: The Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum. (S14, ep 3b).

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups redden Spettergat. A team of pups led by the energetic Ryder are always at the ready when it comes to helping out around the bustling town of Adventure Bay.

programme.title: Paw Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties / Pups Save Helo Humdinger. Mayor Humdinger tricks Katie into watching his kitties in 'Pups Save Katie and Some Kitties', and in 'Pups Save Helo Humdinger', Mayor Humdinger swipes one of Ryder's early inventions. (S9, ep 17).

programme.title: Deer Squad
programme.desc: Catfish Capers / Bubble Debacle. Lola tries her hand at being the park keeper for the day in 'Catfish Capers', and in 'Bubble Debacle', Sir Steel's attempts to clean up with a giant soap machine creates a bubble nightmare!

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You
programme.desc: Blue's Backyard Sports Spectacular. Coach Josh and friends are playing all the sports and getting ready for a soccer game! But Magenta isn't ready for the big game.

programme.title: Tim Rex In Space
programme.desc: Surf / Spaceship / Pizza. Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick. // Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship. // Tim tries to rid the house of a troublesome space bug.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds a Big Bike Shop / The Crew Builds a Super Tub. The Crew builds a shop for the Bike Festival in 'The Crew Builds a Big Bike Shop', and in 'The Crew Builds a Super Tub', the pups build a tub to help Motor with bath time. (S1, ep 2).

programme.title: Santiago Of The Seas
programme.desc: Santiago's Greatest Treasure / The Golden Banana Treasure. Bonnie Bones steals a chest in 'Santiago's Greatest Treasure', then in 'The Golden Banana Treasure', Santi and crew navigate the tricky Banana Island to save a baby monkey from Enrique.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Abuela's Quinceanera / Story Time. Dora throws a super-secret surprise party in 'Abuela's Quinceanera', then in 'Story Time', Dora's friend Coco doesn't have a story, so they go to the Tall Tale Tree in search of one!

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You
programme.desc: The Case of the Missing Thinking Chair. The Case of the Missing Thinking Chair: The Thinking Chair is MISSING! This is a mystery so huge that Josh and Blue need to call in the Blueprints Detective Agency for Steve's help. (S4, ep 11).

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile
programme.desc: Tiny Croc / Camping Croc. Daisy and Mr. Crocodile find a tiny lizard who wants to be just like Mr. Crocodile. Winston tries to be the leader on a nature hike, but his high-tech gadget gets everyone lost in the woods.

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire. The twins visit Barbabright's room in 'Watch Out For Barbabright', then in 'If I Were A Billionaire', everyone thinks about how to achieve their dreams. (S2, ep 13).

programme.title: Barbapapa – One Big Happy Family
programme.desc: The Louvre / Opposite Day. On a trip to Paris, the Barbapapa family will discover the most incredible museum: the Louvre! Barbalala has decided to respect all the rules of the day of opposites.

programme.title: Mr. Bean

programme.title: Tom I Jerry

programme.title: Tom I Jerry

programme.title: Tom I Jerry
programme.desc: Stari neprijatelj. Butch se promijeni zbog grižnje savjesti, ali Tom, Jerry, Spike i Mrvica odluče da više vole starog Butcha.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Leteći medvjed. Leminzi su se domogli posebnih magneta koji sve predmete koji se zakvače za njih pretvara u leteće predmete. Grizzy trpi posljedice kad ga izbace iz kolibe na kauču.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Veliki medvjed. Bičem krotitelja lavova I zdjelicom šećera te uz mnogo truda leminzi su uspješno izdresirali soba da prođe poligon sa zaprekama. Grizzy se divi njihovoj izvedbi.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Električni leming. Grizzy nađe elektroničku verziju rendžerove igračke leminga koja može oponašati pokrete poput pametnog robota. Grizzy odmah shvaća kako je može iskoristiti.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Sredstvo protiv medvjeda. Rendžerova koliba opremljena je izrazito učinkovitim detektorom štetočina koja osjeti uljeza, a zatim ga tjera van odašiljanjem vala koji utječe na njegov mozak.

programme.title: Superthings Rivals Of Kaboom, Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Pass the Spice?. Pratite avanture Kaia i njegovih prijatelja koji su pozvani u Kaboom City da pomognu superherojima u borbi protiv zločestog profesora K.-a i Mr. Kinga.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Macin pidžama party. Maca ostaje prespavati u Bat-pećini, no nije ju lako nagovoriti da doista pođe leći.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Misija plišanac. Redbird bez pitanja uzima Buffova plišanca, koji potom slučajno dopadne u ruke Legije okretnih. Red moli Bama da mu ga pomogne vratiti.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Skakutavi Bam. Bam lovi Pranka i uleti u smjesu zbog koje odskakuje. Mora se naučiti iskoristiti svoju novu sposobnost odskakivanja kako bi zaustavio Pranka.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: Kamion Bem. Bam se mora naučiti prilagoditi i isprobati nešto novo kad ga zamole da odveze kamion do Star Cityja. Tijekom vožnje lovi ga Legija okretnih.

programme.title: Zekoslav Mrkva I Građevinci
programme.desc: Šišmišica Katica. Šunkića muče neke stvari dok Looney građevinci grade naopako okrenuti radijski studio za šišmišicu Katicu, no ne kaže to drugima.

programme.title: Zekoslav Mrkva I Građevinci
programme.desc: Medojedi. Kraljica Matica Košjenka angažira Looney građevince za gradnju punionice meda u svojoj košnici, gdje vrijedi jedno pravilo kojega se građevinci teško drže.

programme.title: Zekoslav Mrkva I Građevinci
programme.desc: Dvorske muke. Engleski princ Lavoslav angažira Looney građevince da mu izgrade sobu za zabave povodom njegova rođendana i svima im naređuje.

programme.title: Zekoslav Mrkva I Građevinci
programme.desc: Modna pista. Mimi Micmac angažira Looney građevince za gradnju modne piste u Francuskoj i potakne ih da učine svoj dizajn upadljivijim i zabavnijim.

programme.title: Zekoslav Mrkva I Građevinci: Vrijeme Je Za Kacige
programme.desc: Ukleta garaža. Noć je vještica i građevinci ukrašavaju radionicu za luniburške malce koji dolaze po slatkiše.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Sladoled. Gospodin Bean želi sladoled iz sladoledarevog kamiona, ali dok dođe na početak reda, sladoledar odlazi na ručak. Bean se penje kroz prozor u unutrašnjost kamiona gdje se počinje samoposluživati.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Rođendanska zabava. Gospodin Bean se osjeća isključenim kad otkrije da gospođa Wicket u prizemlju ima veliku zabavu, a on očito nije pozvan.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Beanovo cvijeće. Bean slučajno pregazi buket gđe Wicket, stoga prikuplja cvijet po cvijet gdje god stigne: iz kafića, mladenkina buketa, čak i od plesača tanga!

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Spašavanje dronom. Beanu ukradu auto, no uz pomoć drona i g. Paliwala prati auto do lopovskog skloništa. Hoće li uspjeti nadmudriti lopove?

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Izvanbrodska brvnara. Pokušavajući izbjeći gliser leminga, Grizli probuši zračni madrac i odleti u skrivenu spilju gdje pronađe školjku ukrašenu maorskim simbolima koja može kontrolirati kitove.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Roditeljsko preopterećenje. Usred svađe medo Grizli i leminzi naiđu na uplakanog medvjedića. Kada ih on ugleda, zaplače još glasnije. Neuspješno ga pokušavaju umiriti. Nakon hranjenja i promjene pelena konačno zaspi.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Privlačni leminzi. Meteorit padne blizu kolibe. Dok se leminzi sanjkaju na poklopcu, privuče ih vanzemaljski kamen. Presretni, nastavljaju igru s antenom.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Ekstremni domino. Leminzi u kolibi postavljaju niz domina koji završava ledenim blokovima i raketom. Medo Grizli ih sabotira da sačuva mir. Raketa raznese kolibu. Grizli se domogne naprave za oblikovanje leda.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Iznenadno odleđivanje. Leminzi pronađu blok leda u kojem je drevna životinja: sabljozubi rakun. Oslobađaju ga i pokušavaju pripitomiti. No nemoguće ga je obuzdati. Grizli se probudi i pobjesni zbog kaosa.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Termalni leminzi. Grizli i leminzi otkriju spremnik s posudama hrane za preživljavanje. Pune su povrća, pa medu više zanima oprema na spremniku. Iza njegovih leđa leminzi nađu posudu Finog i pobjegnu s njom.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Zamjensko jaje. Grizli i leminzi nađu čokoladno jaje. Oblizuju se. U svađi jaje slučajno odbace među pingvine koji ga posvoje. Sjede na jajetu kao da je njihovo.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Zviježđe leminga. Leminzi otvaraju bučni noćni klub s disko kuglom. Grizli ne može spavati. Uzima im kuglu i odbacuje ih u špilju gdje otkrivaju konzolu koja kontrolira zvijezde i polarnu svjetlost.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Veliko kolo leminga. Leminzi nalaze neobičnu alatku među imovinom šumskog rendžera: čarobnu vrtilicu.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Polarna superzvijezda. Ispred pingvina i morževa dvije se ekipe leminga natječu u akrobatskim skokovima. Grizli se slučajno ubaci, ali se brzo uključi i publika podivlja! Opijen pljeskom, medo nije skroman u pobjedi!

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Moj prijatelj pingvin. Dok Grizli lovi ribe, pingvin ugleda praznu kantu. Da pomogne medi, hvata mu ribe. Grizli ga odvede u kolibu, gdje se sprijatelje. No leminzi pingvina zamjene drugim koji nije toliko pametan.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Termalni šok!. Baš kad se Grizli smjestio na kauču, leminzi upadaju na usisivaču. Medo baca punjač u vatru i on eksplodira. Hladnoća ulazi u kolibu.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Primitivne aktivnosti. Leminzi imaju novog prijatelja morža! Jašu na njemu, kližu se niz krov i tako stalno iznova. Grizli ga baca u špilju. Ondje je dolmen i na njemu kost. Tko god je dodirne postaje poslušan.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Koliba na ledu. Dok je Grizli na ribolovu, leminzi pretvaraju kolibu u ledeni tobogan. Medvjed glodavcima kvari zabavu i želi omastiti brk ribom. No leminzi je ukradu i namame ga izvan kolibe.

programme.title: Medo Grizli I Male Napasti
programme.desc: Povratak voljenog bića. Grizli ukrade kip koji ima moć stvoriti želju kada se na njega prikvači fotografija. Na žalost glodavaca, medo Grizli stavlja sliku voljene medvjedice koja je ostala u Kanadi.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Pobjednička fotografija. G. Bean želi snimiti rijetku pticu radi novčane nagrade časopisa o životinjama, no privuče vjeverice koje se goste na hranilici za ptice.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Scrapperova užina. G. Bean kupi čamac na daljinsko upravljanje, no Scrapper pravi probleme i čini se da je progutao dio. Hoće li ga naći na vrijeme za utrku?

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Kaos u kinu. Irma i g. Bean gledaju trosatni ljubić u kinu, no Bean se iskrade na akcijski film o zombijima. Što će biti kad Irma primijeti?

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Otkrivači duhova. G. Bean uredi stan da bude jeziv, kako bi dobio novac od televizijske emisije o ukletim kućama. Hoće li uspjeti nasamariti snimateljsku ekipu?

programme.title: Rovko

programme.title: Rovko

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Dosjei K. Nakon pojave misterioznog svjetla, po Krtoviku krenu glasine o izvanzemaljcima. Rovko i Nora kreću u potragu za istinom.

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Norin katastrofalan dan. Nori kao da ništa ne polazi za rukom, pa odluči Priku povesti sa sobom u pustolovinu. Pritom naleti na Vrtlara, koji smišlja kako da ga ukrade!

programme.title: Krypto Spašava Dan

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani
programme.desc: Smrčak u mraku. Kad Muh-Muh otkrije da se Smrčak boji mraka, predloži da Vrc, Beti i on odvedu Gljikiće na prvi prespavanac u šumskom kampu.

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani

programme.desc: Sat. Gumball i Darwin shvaćaju kako nije lako nagovoriti starca da im vrati nasljedstvo.

programme.desc: Lozinka. Tata je kompjutor zaštitio lozinkom, a pomoćno je pitanje tko je tatino omiljeno dijete.

programme.desc: Savjet. Učitelj Small razočaran je svojim poslom jer smatra da nije dovoljno nadahnuo učenike.

programme.desc: Cura. Jamie je odlučila da treba dečka i kao najboljeg je kandidata izabrala Darwina.

programme.desc: Ljubav. Stanovnici Elmorea pokušavaju shvatiti što je ljubav.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Nelagoda. Gumball se ponovo susretne s dječakom kojeg je pozdravio da se dokaže Darwinu, no ovaj put nastave se slučajno susretati dok nelagoda ne postane nepodnošljiva.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Gnijezdo. Stanovnici Elmorea počnu nestajati, a jedan je od njih susjed Wattersonovih. Tražeći ga, nalaze neobično jaje koje je snijela njihova zla kornjača.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Bodovi. Dok je Tobi zauzet igranjem igrice, Gumball i Darwin odrađuju njegove kućne poslove u zamjenu za bodove – vjerujući da će bodove moći zamijeniti za novac, a novac iskoristiti za igricu.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Autobus. Dok ih vozi u školu, Rocky predloži djeci da markiraju i odu na izlet. No tek što su krenuli, autobus otimaju kriminalci i uzimaju djecu kao taoce.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Noć. Dok noć pada na grad, Mjesec nas vodi kroz snove – i noćne more – usnulih stanovnika Elmorea. San svakog lika otkriva nam njihove želje, strahove, ili jednostavno koliko su zapravo čudni.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput u hotelu. Lamput se skriva u otmjenom hotelu, pa Očalinko i Žgoljavi glume bogataše. U apartmanu za mladence hodaju u ogrtačima i skaču po krevetima. Loveći Lamputa unište apartman i odlaze u restoran.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Nesporazumi. Gumball je pogrešno shvatio dogovor s Penny pa žuri u trgovački centar da se nađe s njom na ručku. Putem susreće raznorazne likove koji ga svi pogrešno razumiju, a on sve više kasni.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet
programme.desc: Izbor. Slučajni susret sa ženom njegovih snova nadahne Rockyja da prestane živjeti online i da nađe ljubav uz pomoć aplikacije za upoznavanje.

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet

programme.title: Gumballov Čudesni Svijet

programme.title: Rejouez ! A La Recherche Des Boucles
programme.desc: La répétition est l'un des principes de la composition. Au fil de l'histoire de la musique occidentale, les exemples abondent : comme les motets médiévaux de Josquin Desprez.

programme.title: Silvesterkonzert Staatskapelle Dresden
programme.desc: Au programme : Oeuvres de Huppertz, Erwin, Heymann, Profes, Gershwin, Casucci, Johann Strauss fils, Franz Lehar, Abraham, Santugini et Benatzky.

programme.title: Berliner Philharmoniker, Kirill Petrenko : Europakonzert 2022
programme.desc: Kirill Petrenko, à la tête de l'Orchestre Philharmonique de Berlin, avec la mezzo-soprano lettone Elina Garanca, participe à l'Europakonzert 2022 qui se tient en Lettonie.

programme.title: La Bella Otero
programme.desc: La Bella Otero Chorégraphie : Ruben Olmo.

programme.title: Lille Piano(s) Festival
programme.desc: Judith Jáuregui & Quatuor Gerhard. Au programme : "Quintette pour piano et cordes" en la majeur, d'Antonín Dvořák ; "Quintette pour piano et cordes" en sol mineur op. 49, d'Enrique Granados.

programme.title: The Cleveland Orchestra, Marc André Hamelin : Copland, Gershwin, Ellington
programme.desc: The Cleveland Orchestra, Marc-André Hamelin : Copland, Gershwin, Ellington. Aaron Copland 1900 – 1990 Suite de "Appalachian Spring" (orchestration de 1945) George Gershwin 1898 – 1937 Rhapsody in Blue (version originale pour groupe de jazz arrangée par Ferde Grofe) Duke...

programme.title: Jephtha
programme.desc: Georg Frideric Haendel 1685 – 1759 Jephtha Oratorio en trois actes Livret de Thomas Morell Londres, Covent Garden, 26 février 1752.

programme.title: Intermezzo
programme.desc: Un florilège d'extraits musicaux, une façon différente et extrêmement variée de découvrir la musique, les interprètes et les orchestres.

programme.title: Dianne Reeves Avec Romero Lubambo – Festival International De Jazz De Montréal
programme.desc: La chanteuse Dianne Reeves s'associe au guitariste brésilien Romero Lubambo pour un concert intime mêlant jazz, blues et bossa nova au Festival de Jazz de Montréal.

programme.title: Tyreek McDole

programme.title: Ict Business Tv
programme.desc: Telekomi traže novu vrijednost, a sve je u igri od infrastrukture do inteligencije. MWC 2026 pokazao je da telekom i ICT industrija ulaze u fazu u kojoj sama povezivost više nije dovoljna za dugoročan rast.

programme.title: Ict Na Ti
programme.desc: Telekom više nije samo mreža, a Hrvatska mora odlučiti želi li biti tržište usluga ili strateška digitalna infrastruktura. programme.title: Ict Business Tv
programme.desc: AI, spektar i mreže budućnosti. Ovogodišnji MWC u Barceloni pokazuje da se telekom industrija istodobno suočava s pritiskom na postojeće resurse i otvara prostor za potpuno nove načine upravljanja mrežama.

programme.desc: Pridružite se Peći i Vuku u svakodnevnim avanturama i susretima sa najneverovatnijim likovima: zombijima, robotima, vampirima, vukodlacima, divovima, vilama i mnogim drugim čudesnim bićima.

programme.title: Gladijatorska Akademija
programme.desc: Četiri gladijatora odlučila su da zaštite svoju zemlju od čudovišta, osvajača i zlog rimskog cara.

programme.title: Radoznalci
programme.desc: Šta biste uradili kada bi vam jednog dana neki vanzemaljac došao u kuću, a vi morate da ga naučite da živi na Zemlji? Radoznalcima, Maji, Aci i Jani ovaj zadatak nije bio ni malo težak.

programme.title: Bleja
programme.desc: "Bleja" je kratka igrana struktura u trajanju od desetak minuta, u kojoj pratimo svakodnevna dešavanja u ulazu jedne stambene zgrade u Beogradu.

programme.title: Plava Ptica
programme.desc: Plavoptičasti trikovi!. Od krotitelja magičnih kockica i novčića stiže specijal ispunjen čistom magijom! Dobro... i čašama, kašikama, selotejpom i ostalim rekvizitama za trikove.

programme.title: Plaško Hrabrović Uzvraća Udarac
programme.desc: Plaško Hrabrović uzvraća udarac!. Serija o dečjim strahovima od mraka, preko javnog nastupa, buba, čudovišta i svega onoga što nas plaši i čime su nas plašili, ali i tome šta se dešava voditelju Plašku iza kamera.

programme.title: Porodične Priče
programme.desc: Serijal Redakcije školskog programa o svim važnim temama koje su vezane za roditeljstvo i obrazovanje.

programme.title: Ogledi Iz Jezika
programme.desc: Padeži.

programme.title: Geografski Podsetnik
programme.desc: Kako se pravi karta. Obrazovna serija Školskog programa Radio-televizije Srbije emitovala se tokom devedesetih godina prošlog veka, a u fokusu je imala kratke geografske lekcije.

programme.title: Eko Perspektive
programme.desc: Šumski velnes. U novoj emisiji serijala "Eko perspektive" posvećenoj šumskom velnesu, naša ekipa prati grupu naučnika i studenata tokom nesvakidašnje avanture u čudesnom okruženju Obedske bare, jednog od...

programme.title: Eko Minijature: Biljke Kao Začin
programme.desc: Biljke kao začin – šta su začini. Danas su začinske biljke dostupne svima i ne razmišljamo mnogo o njima kada ih koristimo u kulinarstvu. Ali nije oduvek bilo tako.

programme.title: Eko Perspektive
programme.desc: Televizijski serijal kreiran od strane ekološke redakcije, donosi nam razgovore sa vrhunskim stručnjacima iz oblasti očuvanja životne sredine i ekologije.

programme.title: Eko Minijature: Spomenar Iz Srbije
programme.desc: Emisija o očuvanju prirode i maštovitim rešenjima za brojne ekološke probleme. Poslušajte priče i iskustva ljudi koji su često pokretači promena u svojim sredinama.

programme.title: Velika Iluzija
programme.desc: Zabavni, strašni, hrabri, tužni, uzbudljivi, drski, crno-beli, u boji, domaći, strani, drugačiji, omiljeni, komercijalni, umetnički – svi filmovi i sve o filmovima u autorskoj emisiji Sandre Perović.

programme.title: Od Zlata Jabuka
programme.desc: Emisija prati muzičke događaje i ličnosti koje neguju izvorno muzičko stvaralaštvo. Ona okuplja istraživače, melografe, etnologe, etnomuzikologe i izvođače.

programme.title: Tv Lica... Kao Sav Normalan Svet
programme.desc: Emisija Tanje Peternek Aleksić emituje se na javnom servisu od 2002. godine. U svakoj emisiji, autorka razgovara sa gostima na lokacijama koje su važne za sagovornike.

programme.title: Dinastija
programme.desc: My Family, My Blood. Serija počinje sa naslednicom Falon Karington koja nije zadovoljna što je njen otac, milijarder Blejk, veren za Kristal, njenu suparnicu i zaposlenu u porodičnom preduzeću.

programme.title: Neverbalna Komunikacija
programme.desc: Samopouzdanje. Emisija kratke forme koja će vam pomoći da bolje razumete sistem znakova neverbalne komunikacije.

programme.title: Da Li Ste Znali
programme.desc: Da li ste znali?. Emisija "Da li ste znali" istraživajući svet kroz nauku razdvaja činjenice od mitova i legendi. Otkriva tajne života oko nas i predstavlja najnovije tehnologije i istraživanja.

programme.title: Iz Senke Prošlosti
programme.desc: Masoni u Prvom balkanskom ratu. U događajima koji su prethodili Prvom i balkanskom ratu značajnu ulogu je imao Damjan Branković preko svojih poslovnih, a naročito masonskih veza.

programme.title: Kliker Za Biznis
programme.desc: Šta preduzetnika čini uspešnim? "Kliker za biznis" vodi vas u priče talentovanih i vrednih preduzetnika, koji se svojim poslom bave na inovativan i zanimljiv način.

programme.title: Znanje Imanje
programme.desc: Karavan Znanje imanje obilazi sela Srbije i beleži sve muke i radosti našeg domaćina. Emisija se isključivo bavi životom i radom naših poljoprivrednih proizvođača kako bi opstala naša sela.

programme.title: Neverbalna Komunikacija
